newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH TO MISS BOTH BRAZILIANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH TO MISS BOTH BRAZILIANS.

text.p: English premier league club Middlesbrough will be without Brazilians Emerson and Juninho as they bid to halt their slide towards the relegation zone against Leicester at home on Tuesday night.

Emerson has completed his three-match league suspension but was given permission to fly home on Friday with the aim of returning to Teesside with his wife Andrea to try and sort out the problems the couple have been experiencing in settling in the area.
Manager Bryan Robson said: "He will miss the Leicester game but it is better to get everything resolved rather than to let this situation drag on."

Robson could have done with the services of Emerson as he faces an injury crisis which has also claimed Juninho. He will be out for three weeks after he picked up an ankle injury in Saturday's defeat at Aston Villa.
Boro will also miss skipper Nigel Pearson, who has not recovered from a neck injury while fellow defender Steve Vickers is again doubtful with a knee problem.
